_comment: Retrieval gold set for MahaGR Assist. Each in-corpus question names the GR that SHOULD be retrieved, matched as a substring against a hit's order_id / gr_number / source_file / title. in_corpus:false questions MUST be abstained on (used to calibrate the refusal threshold). Corpus = 196 real Higher & Technical Education GRs (orgpedia) + 2 synthetic fee-table GRs. Mix of English and Marathi, including cross-lingual pairs (same GR asked in both languages).
